The premium soy candle by VERA YOUNG, is handmade from natural plant waxes. The fragrances used are created according to proprietary recipes specially developed for the Vera Young brand in Europe.
The Norwegian Woods fragrance allows you to be transported deep into the forest with an intense, powerful aroma. The head notes are dominated by pine and eucalyptus, creating a fresh and energising experience. The heart composition is a pure scent of pine that envelops you in a forest freshness. In the base of the fragrance, you'll find a combination of pine, cedar, delicate sandalwood and subtle hints of musk that give the overall fragrance longevity and depth. It's not just the scent of forest wood, it's a journey into nature that imbues your home with the intense aroma of the forest, creating an atmosphere of peace and harmony.
Soy candles are a healthier and more environmentally friendly alternative to traditional paraffin candles. The absence of paraffin in the composition of VERA YOUNG candles is important because it means fewer toxins, better performance, a more environmentally friendly origin of the wax and a cleaner and more intense release of fragrances.
The burning time of the candle is approximately 70 hours*. The candle has a wooden wick, which burns more evenly, longer and creates a pleasant crackling effect and emits less soot and smoke than .
Each candle is packaged in an elegant cardboard box and has a description of how to use it, so that everyone can enjoy this special gift for as long as possible.
* VERA YOUNG candles burn 20 hours longer than candles from other manufacturers of the same capacity.
Ecological candle, safe for health, free of harmful substances.
The wooden wick may vary in appearance depending on the type of production.
Manufactured in the EU.
